name: Performance Pit Stop
title: Improve Dashboard Render Performance
description: The dashboard is slow with 10,000 rows. Improve render time without changing the UI.
prompt:
You are working on the app in the repository at {{repo_path}}. A performance issue has been reported:

"The dashboard takes over 4 seconds to render when loading 10,000 rows of data. This is unacceptable."

Your task:
1. Profile the current code to identify the bottleneck in generate_dashboard_data()
2. Optimize _render_dashboard_row() to eliminate the O(n²) behavior
3. The benchmark (python3 app.py --benchmark) should complete in under 2 seconds
4. All existing tests must still pass
5. The output structure (label, value, count fields) must be maintained

Work step by step. First measure, then optimize, then validate.
agent_hint: This is a PERFORMANCE problem, not a correctness bug. The dashboard render is slow because a per-row helper does O(n^2) work (repeated/nested scanning inside the row rendering loop). Find the render-row function, eliminate the redundant inner work (precompute once outside the loop or use a lookup), and confirm with the --benchmark check. Do not change the output/UI — only make it fast.

tests: cd {{repo_path}} && python3 -m pytest tests/test_app.py -k 'not promo and not filter' -v
